answer: 1 Thessalonians 5:18 Be thankful in all circumstances, for this is God’s will for you who belong to Christ Jesus.

text: According to John's gospel, why did Jesus come to earth?
answer: John 10:10 The thief’s purpose is to steal and kill and destroy. My purpose is to give them a rich and satisfying life.

text: According to Luke's gospel, why did Jesus come to earth?
answer: Luke 19:10 For the Son of Man came to seek and save those who are lost.

text: According to Zechariah, how can we do God's work?
answer: Zechariah 4:6 It is not by force nor by strength, but by my Spirit, says the LORD.

text: How did Jesus say His baptism would be different from John's?
answer: Acts 1:5 John baptized with water, but in just a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.

text: How did Jesus say we may show our love for him?
answer: John 14:15 If you love me, obey my commandments.

text: How long will the Bible last?
answer: Matthew 24:35 Heaven and earth will disappear, but my words will never disappear.

text: Quote the verse from First Corinthians in which Paul explains the purpose of the Lord's supper.
answer: 1 Corinthians 11:26 For every time you eat this bread and drink this cup, you are announcing the Lord’s death until he comes again.

text: Quote the verse of Acts chapter two that describes the disciples of Jesus receiving the outpouring of the Holy Spirit.
answer: Acts 2:4 And everyone present was filled with the Holy Spirit and began speaking in other languages, as the Holy Spirit gave them this ability.

text: Quote the verse of Ephesians chapter two which tells us how we are saved.
answer: Ephesians 2:8 God saved you by his grace when you believed. And you can’t take credit for this; it is a gift from God.

text: Quote the verse of Philippians that expresses what the Christian's attitude should be toward both life and death.
answer: Philippians 1:21 For to me, living means living for Christ, and dying is even better.

text: Quote the verse of Romans chapter five which tells us the greatest proof of God's love?
answer: Romans 5:8 But God showed his great love for us by sending Christ to die for us while we were still sinners.

text: Quote the verse of Romans chapter one which tells us the power of gospel?
answer: Romans 1:16 For I am not ashamed of this Good News about Christ. It is the power of God at work, saving everyone who believes

text: Quote the verse that says Jesus is always the same?
answer: Hebrews 13:8 Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

text: Quote the verse which tells why it is necessary to live a peaceful and holy life?
answer: Hebrews 12:14 Work at living in peace with everyone, and work at living a holy life, for those who are not holy will not see the Lord.

text: What are the three great Christian virtues?
answer: 1 Corinthians 13:13 Three things will last forever—faith, hope, and love—and the greatest of these is love.

text: What does James say we must do to keep from fooling ourselves?
answer: James 1:22 But don’t just listen to God’s word. You must do what it says. Otherwise, you are only fooling yourselves.

text: What part did Jesus have in creation?
answer: John 1:3-4 God created everything through him, and nothing was created except through him. The Word gave life to everything that was created, and his life brought light to everyone.

text: What power is there in united prayer?
answer: Matthew 18:19 If two of you agree here on earth concerning anything you ask, my Father in heaven will do it for you.

text: What rule do we find in Proverbs for avoiding trouble with others?
answer: Proverbs 15:1 A gentle answer deflects anger but harsh words make tempers flare.

text: What did Jesus say was the first and most important commandment?
answer: Mark 12:30 You must love the LORD your God with all your heart, all your soul, all your mind, and all your strength.

text: What did Jesus say was the second most important commandment?
answer: Mark 12:31 Love your neighbor as yourself.

text: What did Jesus say was the greatest display of love?
answer: John 15:13 There is no greater love than to lay down one’s life for one’s friends.

text: What did Jesus say would cause the world to know that we are His disciples?
answer: John 13:35 Your love for one another will prove to the world that you are my disciples

text: What did Jesus tell Nicodemus was necessary for a person to see the kingdom of God?
answer: John 3:3 I tell you the truth, unless you are born again, you cannot see the Kingdom of God.”

text: What did Peter tell the people at Pentecost to do in order to receive the gift of the Holy Spirit?
answer: Acts 2:38 Each of you must repent of your sins and turn to God, and be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins. Then you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

text: What is Jesus' great "I am" saying in the Book of Revelation?
answer: Revelation 22:13 I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.

text: What is the Golden Rule?
answer: Matthew 7:12 Do to others whatever you would like them to do to you.

text: What is the mission of the church?
answer: Mark 16:15 “Go into all the world and preach the Good News to everyone.”

text: At the communion service, who is to judge who is worthy to partake?
answer: Everyone should examine themselves.

text: First John 3:4 contains what definition of sin?
answer: Sin is breaking God’s law and is contrary to the law of God.

text: For whom did God prepare hell?
answer: The devil and his demons

text: James 4:17 contains what definition of sin?
answer: Knowing to do good but not doing it is sin.

text: More than how many people saw Jesus after he was raised from the dead?
answer: [More than] 500

text: Name five things that will not be found in heaven?
answer: Tears, Death, Sorrow, Pain, Evil

text: Over how many different Old Testament prophecies were fulfilled by the life and death of Jesus?
answer: [Over] 300

text: Paul said if God was for us no one could be against us. How do we know God is for us?
answer: God sent His son [Jesus] to die for us.

text: Since we are saved because of what Jesus did and not what we do, why should Christians do good things?
answer: Because we are saved, we do good things to show our love for God

text: The Holy Spirit guides Christians into what?
answer: Truth

text: There are over how many references in the New Testament to the second coming of Christ?
answer: [Over] 300

text: According to Ecclesiastes 12:1, when should we begin to seek God?
answer: In our youth

text: According to First John, what are the three common temptations?
answer: Craving for physical pleasure, craving for everything we see, Pride [in our achievements and possessions]

text: According to Hebrews 11:6, those who come to God must believe what?
answer: They must believe that God exists and that He rewards those who sincerely seek Him

text: Does the Bible claim to be inspired?
answer: Yes. The words, "and God said," or their equivalent, are found over 2,500 times in the Bible.

text: Does the Holy Spirit dwell in every Christian?
answer: Yes, the Holy Spirit comes into our hearts when we believe on Jesus.

text: How long did Jesus walk and talk with His apostles after His death?
answer: 40 days

text: How was God's first promise of a Savior fulfilled?
answer: Through Jesus' death and resurrection, Satan's power was conquered.

text: How were people created in the image of God?
answer: People were created with spiritual natures which permit them to reason, make choices, and to know and love God.

text: How did death come into the world?
answer: Death first came as a result of willful sin.

text: How did God anoint Jesus?
answer: With the Holy Spirit and power

text: How did God create man?
answer: He formed man from the dust of the ground [earth] and breathed the breath of life into him.

text: How did God create woman?
answer: God made woman out of one of the ribs of Adam.

text: How did God give us the Bible?
answer: The Holy Spirit inspired holy men, giving them both the truth and the words to write.

text: How did Jesus overcome the temptations of Satan?
answer: By using the Scriptures

text: How does Jeremiah 1:5 proclaim God’s value and plan for our life?
answer: [The Lord gave me this message:] “I knew you before I formed you in your mother’s womb. Before you were born I set you apart.”

text: How important is the blood of Jesus to our salvation?
answer: Without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness of sin.

text: How important is the doctrine of resurrection to our Christian faith?
answer: If Christ was not raised from the dead, our faith is useless.

text: How should a church be supported?
answer: By tithes and offerings from those to whom it ministers

text: How should we regard our school teachers, policemen, and other government authorities?
answer: We should obey them because their authority comes from God.

text: How should we regard our Sunday school teachers, pastors, and other church leaders?
answer: We should obey them because they are responsible to God for our souls.

text: In communion, what is symbolized by the bread and the cup?
answer: The bread represents the body of Jesus, and the cup represents His blood which He shed for our sins.

text: In First Corinthians chapter 15, what illustration does Paul use to explain the resurrection of Christians?
answer: The sprouting of a new plant from a seed

text: In Jesus' story of the Pharisee and tax collector, what was the tax collector's prayer?
answer: “O God, be merciful to me, for I am a sinner.”

text: In relationship to our salvation, what is meant by "adoption"?
answer: All the privileges of being a child of God, including inheriting eternal life, are restored.

text: In the Parable of the Good Shepherd, what did Jesus say the Good Shepherd would do for the sheep?
answer: Sacrifice his life

text: In whose name should Christians be baptized?
answer: In the name of the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit

text: Is it a sin to be tempted?
answer: No, it is sin only when we yield to temptation.

text: Is it God's will for all people to be saved?
answer: Yes, God wants all people to be saved, but each individual must personally choose Christ as Savior.

text: Is the baptism in the Holy Spirit the same as salvation?
answer: No, Paul asked the Ephesian Christians if they had received the Holy Spirit since they believed.

text: Jesus said that God had planned for His house to be used as what?
answer: A house of prayer

text: Jesus said that the age or time of His return will be like the days of whom?
answer: Noah and Lot

text: Jesus said the Holy Spirit would convict, or reprove, the world of what three things?
answer: Sin, Righteousness, and Judgment

text: What chapter of the Bible is known as the "love chapter"?
answer: 1 Corinthians 13

text: What confession of faith in eternal life and resurrection did Job make?
answer: Job declared that even though he would die and his body decay he would be resurrected and see God.

text: What happens to a Christian's soul and spirit at death?
answer: The Christian's soul and spirit go immediately to be with the Lord.

text: What Hebrew word is the same as the Greek word "Christ"?
answer: Messiah

text: What instructions did Paul give Christians for getting along with other people?
answer: Live in harmony with each other. Don’t be too proud to enjoy the company of ordinary people. Don’t think you know it all.

text: What kind of worship does God desire?
answer: God desires us to worship in spirit and in truth.

text: What promise did God make to Abraham?
answer: God promised Abraham that through his descendant all the earth would be blessed.

text: What prophecy did Isaiah make concerning Jesus' power to heal?
answer: He took our sicknesses and removed our diseases

text: What should a Christian's attitude be toward spiritism, astrology, and other occult practices?
answer: Christians should avoid all occult practices because Scripture specifically forbids them.

text: What story of Jesus indicates that both the righteous and the wicked are conscious after death?
answer: The story of Lazarus and the rich man

text: What wise king wrote much of the Book of Proverbs?
answer: Solomon

text: What are offerings?
answer: Something given in worship or devotion to God in addition to the tithe

text: What are the continuing spiritual evidences of the Spirit-filled life?
answer: Joy and contentment, Victory over sin, Ability [power] to share the gospel, Desire to know God and His Word

text: What are the four major divisions of the Old Testament?
answer: Law, History, Poetry, Prophets

text: What are the purposes of the baptism in the Holy Spirit?
answer: To help us know Christ [Jesus] better, to assist us in understanding God's Word, To give us power to witness

text: What are the three main sources of temptation?
answer: Devil, The world, Our own evil desires

text: What are the two ordinances of the Church?
answer: Water baptism and Communion

text: What did Paul tell Timothy was great wealth?
answer: True Godliness with contentment is great wealth.

text: What did Paul tell the Ephesians was God’s guarantee of our inheritance?
answer: The Holy Spirit, promised long ago

text: What did the prodigal son say to his father when he came back home?
answer: “Father I have sinned against both heaven [God] and you, and I am no longer worthy of being called your son.”

text: What do we mean by a "calling to the ministry"?
answer: A person must have a special impression of the Spirit to serve the Lord through a particular area of ministry.

text: What do we mean when we say that God is eternal?
answer: God has neither beginning nor ending, but always has been and always will be.

text: What do we mean when we say that God is omnipresent?
answer: God is everywhere at the same time.

text: What do we mean when we say that God is omnipotent?
answer: God is all-powerful.

text: What do we mean when we say that God is omniscient?
answer: God is all-wise and all-knowing.

text: What do we mean when we say the Bible is infallible?
answer: The Bible cannot fail and has no errors.

text: What do we mean when we say the Bible is verbally inspired?
answer: God inspired each word of the Bible, not just the thoughts or ideas.

text: What do we mean when we say the Bible is our authoritative rule of faith and conduct?
answer: The Bible has the right to command us in what we believe and what we do.

text: What do we mean when we speak of the Antichrist?
answer: The man who will rule the world during the Great Tribulation and will attempt to make all people worship him as God.

text: What do we mean when we speak of the "revelation" of Christ?
answer: His return to earth to rule and reign for 1000 years following the Great Tribulation

text: What does intercession mean?
answer: To pray to God for someone else

text: What does it mean to be born again?
answer: The Holy Spirit gives birth to spiritual life; we become a new person.

text: What does James instruct us to do if we are sick?
answer: We should ask the elders [ministers] to anoint us with oil and pray for God to heal us.

text: What does Paul mean when he says that all have sinned and fall short of God’s glorious standard?
answer: People, by their own ability, cannot attain the righteousness of God.

text: What does Romans 8:26 say is the main weakness of our prayers?
answer: We don’t know what God wants us to pray for.

text: What does the Bible declare is the foundation of wisdom?
answer: Fear of [respect for] God

text: What is a great lesson from the Book of Job?
answer: Not all misfortune which comes to a believer is punishment for sin.

text: What is a parable?
answer: A parable is a story about familiar things which helps us understand spiritual truths.

text: What is done by everyone who looks for Christ's appearing?
answer: They keep themselves pure.

text: What is heaven?
answer: Heaven is the place of eternal joy which God is preparing for those who love Him and accept Jesus [Christ] as their Savior.

text: What is hell?
answer: A place of eternal fire, punishment, and torment

text: What is symbolized, or pictured, by water baptism?
answer: The death of the old sinful nature and a new life in Christ

text: What is Jesus' title of divinity?
answer: Son of God

text: What is Jesus' title of humanity?
answer: Son of Man

text: What is meant by "original sin"?
answer: Because Adam and Eve chose to sin, all people are born in sin and have the tendency to sin.

text: What is meant by the vicarious atonement?
answer: Jesus [Christ] took the punishment for our sins when He died on Calvary, and if we accept Him as Savior we will not have to be punished by God.

text: What is the Christian's blessed hope?
answer: The return of Jesus [Christ]

text: What is the church?
answer: A body [company] of born-again people who have been called out from the world; who have faith in and give allegiance to the Lord Jesus Christ

text: What is the doctrine of Jesus' Incarnation?
answer: God the Son became flesh/human and lived among us.

text: What is the Great Tribulation?
answer: The Great Tribulation is a period of extreme trouble and turmoil before the final judgement.

text: What is the importance of the doctrine of Jesus' virgin birth?
answer: Jesus did not have an earthly father. Because of His supernatural birth, Jesus was both fully God and fully human.

text: What is the initial physical evidence of the baptism in the Holy Spirit?
answer: Speaking in other languages [tongues] as the Holy Spirit enables

text: What is the last enemy to be destroyed?
answer: Death

text: What is the main theme of the Book of Hebrews?
answer: That Jesus is a better priest [mediator] between God and people than were the Old Testament priests

text: What is the millennium?
answer: A future period of one thousand years when Jesus [Christ] shall rule over the earth

text: What is the only sin which will not be forgiven?
answer: Willfully and knowingly speaking evil against [blaspheming] the Holy Spirit

text: What is the proper method of water baptism?
answer: Immersion in water

text: What is the rapture?
answer: When Jesus [Christ] returns to take His church - the believers both dead and living - out of this world

text: What is the tithe?
answer: One-tenth of one's income, which belongs to God and should be given to the church to support its ministries

text: What is the meaning of the name "Jesus"?
answer: The Lord is our Savior.

text: What is the meaning of the word Christ?
answer: The Anointed One of God

text: What part did God the Father have in creation?
answer: God the Father gave the commands that caused the visible world to be created out of nothing.

text: What part did the Holy Spirit have in creation?
answer: The Spirit of God was hovering over the surface of the waters.

text: What part does the Holy Spirit have in our salvation?
answer: The Holy Spirit convicts of sin and makes the repentant sinner a new person.

text: What three things does Paul say make up God's kingdom?
answer: Righteousness [living a life of goodness], Peace, and Joy in the Holy Spirit

text: What three figures of speech do the Bible writers use to describe the church?
answer: A body, A building, A bride

text: What two appointments will all people keep?
answer: Death and judgment

text: What two events will happen in heaven shortly after the Rapture?
answer: The judgment of Christians and the wedding feast of the Lamb

text: What two great events comprise the second coming of Christ?
answer: The Rapture and Christ's revelation

text: What was God's first promise of a Savior?
answer: God told the serpent that one of Eve's descendants would defeat him.

text: What was proven by Jesus' resurrection?
answer: That Jesus was exactly who He claimed to be-Son of God, Savior, and Lord

text: What was the purpose of Jesus' miracles?
answer: They showed God the Father's endorsement [approval] of Him.

text: What were Jesus' disciples doing in preparation for being baptized in the Holy Spirit?
answer: They were praying.

text: What were the duties of the Old Testament priest?
answer: To intercede with God for the people and offer sacrifices to atone for their sins

text: What will happen at the conclusion of the Millennium?
answer: Satan will be loosed from the bottomless pit, and Christ [Jesus] will completely conquer him and his followers.

text: What will happen to Satan during the Millennium?
answer: He will be imprisoned in a bottomless pit so that he cannot tempt people.

text: When Adam and Eve sinned, how did God provide them clothing?
answer: He made them clothing from the skins of animals.

text: When did God first baptize believers in the Holy Spirit?
answer: On the Day of Pentecost

text: When will Christians who have died be resurrected?
answer: At the rapture of the church

text: Where did the devil come from?
answer: The devil [Satan] was an angel created by God whom God had to punish for trying to make himself greater than God.

text: Where is Jesus now and what is He doing?
answer: Jesus is at the right hand of the Father interceding [pleading] for believers.

text: Which chapter of the Bible is known as the "resurrection chapter"?
answer: 1 Corinthians 15

text: Which Gospel proves that Jesus is the Messiah by showing the fulfillment of many Old Testament prophecies?
answer: Matthew

text: Which of Jesus' parables tells us that some who claim to be Christians will be unprepared for His return?
answer: The Parable of the Five Wise and Five bridesmaids

text: Which two apostles wrote a Gospel?
answer: Matthew and John

text: Which two Old Testament books tell the history of the Jews after their return from captivity in Babylon?
answer: Ezra and Nehemiah

text: Who builds the church?
answer: Jesus [Christ]

text: Who fulfilled God's promise that Abraham's descendant would bless the whole earth?
answer: [Jesus] Christ

text: Who intercedes for the Christian?
answer: The Holy Spirit and Jesus

text: Who knows when the Rapture will occur?
answer: Only God the Father

text: Who should be baptized in water?
answer: Every person who believes in Jesus [Christ] as Savior

text: Who was the first person in the Bible to pay tithes and to whom did he pay them?
answer: Abraham paid tithes to Melchizedek.

text: Who wrote the first 5 books of the Bible?
answer: Moses

text: Who are the four major prophets?
answer: Isaiah, Jeremiah, Ezekiel, Daniel

text: Who are the three Persons of the Trinity?
answer: God the Father, God the Son, God the Holy Spirit

text: Who is the foundation of the church?
answer: Jesus [Christ]

text: Who is the Head of the church?
answer: Jesus [Christ]

text: Who will be resurrected?
answer: Both the righteous and the wicked – the righteous to receive eternal life and the wicked to receive eternal punishment

text: Who will spend eternity in heaven?
answer: Those who accept Christ [Jesus] as Savior and whose names are written in the Lamb's Book of Life

text: Who will spend eternity in the lake of fire?
answer: All who refuse Christ [Jesus] as Savior and whose names are not written in the Lamb's Book of Life

text: Whom does God oppose, and to whom does He give grace?
answer: God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble.

text: Whom does the Holy Spirit glorify?
answer: Jesus [Christ]

text: Why can't evil powers control a Christian?
answer: Because the [Holy] Spirit who lives in you is greater than the spirit who lives in the world

text: Why were the Christians at Berea honored?
answer: Because they received the Word eagerly and studied the Scriptures every day

text: Why did God instruct Joseph to call Mary's son "Jesus"?
answer: Because He would save His people from their sins

text: Why did Jesus say it was necessary that He go away?
answer: So that the Advocate [Holy Spirit] might come

text: Why do Christians traditionally worship on Sunday instead of the Sabbath?
answer: Because Jesus fulfilled the Sabbath, we worship and rest on the day of his resurrection

text: Why do we believe that speaking with other tongues is the initial physical evidence of the baptism in the Holy Spirit?
answer: Because it is the pattern of the New Testament Church

text: Why does God give ministers to the church?
answer: To help Christians grow so they can help others

text: Why does the Holy Spirit convict, or reprove, the world of sin?
answer: Because the world failed to believe on Jesus

text: Why is it absolutely necessary to our salvation that Jesus lived a sinless life?
answer: If Jesus had sinned then His death would have been the penalty of His sin and would not have had power to atone for our sins.

text: Why is the devil not as powerful as God?
answer: The devil was created by God and has been defeated by Jesus' death and resurrection.

text: Why should a Christian keep pure in body and mind, before and after marriage?
answer: Because immoral behavior destroys the purity and happiness God intends marriage to have

text: Why should a Christian not marry a person who is not a Christian?
answer: Because God’s Word says we should not team up with an unbeliever

text: Why should the coming of Jesus not surprise the Christians?
answer: Because Christians do not live in the darkness

text: Why should we be careful about what we think?
answer: Because our thoughts determine who we are and what we say and do

text: As listed in Galatians, what is the fruit of the Spirit?
answer: Galatians 5:22-23 But the Holy Spirit produces this kind of fruit in our lives: love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, and self-control. There is no law against these things!

text: At Jesus' ascension, what prophecy was made concerning His return?
answer: Acts 1:11 Jesus has been taken from you into heaven, but someday he will return from heaven in the same way you saw him go!

text: Do all things that happen to a Christian have a purpose?
answer: Romans 8:28 And we know that God causes everything to work together for the good of those who love God and are called according to his purpose for them.

text: In the Sermon on the Mount, what did Jesus say was His relationship to the Law and the Prophets?
answer: Matthew 5:17 Don’t misunderstand why I have come. I did not come to abolish the law of Moses or the writings of the prophets. No, I came to accomplish their purpose.

text: Is all the Bible inspired?
answer: 2 Timothy 3:16 All Scripture is inspired by God and is useful to teach us what is true and to make us realize what is wrong in our lives. It corrects us when we are wrong and teaches us to do what is right.

text: To whom is the promise of the baptism in the Holy Spirit given?
answer: Acts 2:39 This promise is to you, to your children, and to those far away—all who have been called by the Lord our God.

text: When Thomas asked about the way to heaven, what did Jesus say?
answer: John 14:6 I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one can come to the Father except through me.

text: Who can become God's children?
answer: John 1:11-12 He came to his own people, and even they rejected him. But to all who believed him and accepted him, he gave the right to become children of God.

text: According to Ephesians chapter four, how should we treat others?
answer: Ephesians 4:32 Be kind to each other, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, just as God through Christ has forgiven you.

text: According to Philippians chapter one, what assurance do we have that God is able to keep us?
answer: Philippians 1:6 And I am certain that God, who began the good work within you, will continue his work until it is finally finished on the day when Christ Jesus returns.

text: According to Romans chapter eight, what things cannot separate us from God's love?
answer: Romans 8:38-39 And I am convinced that nothing can ever separate us from God’s love. Neither death nor life, neither angels nor demons, neither our fears for today nor our worries about tomorrow—not even the powers of hell can separate us from God’s love. No power in the sky above or in the earth below—indeed, nothing in all creation will ever be able to separate us from the love of God that is revealed in Christ Jesus our Lord.

text: According to Romans chapter ten, what should we do to be saved?
answer: Romans 10:9 If you openly declare that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

text: According to Romans twelve verse one, what does God desire from each Christian?
answer: Romans 12:1 And so, dear brothers and sisters, I plead with you to give your bodies to God because of all he has done for you. Let them be a living and holy sacrifice—the kind he will find acceptable. This is truly the way to worship him.

text: According to Romans chapter twelve, how is the Church compared to a body?
answer: Romans 12:4-5 Just as our bodies have many parts and each part has a special function, so it is with Christ’s body. We are many parts of one body, and we all belong to each other.

text: According to the First Epistle of John, what should Christians do if they sin?
answer: 1 John 1:9 But if we confess our sins to him, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all wickedness.

text: From Matthew, quote the Great Commission.
answer: Matthew 28:19 Therefore, go and make disciples of all the nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit.

text: From the first Psalm, quote the definition of the blessed person.
answer: Psalm 1:1 Oh, the joys of those who do notfollow the advice of the wicked, or stand around with sinners, or join in with mockers.

text: How can we determine God's will for our lives?
answer: Proverbs 3:5-6 Trust in the LORD with all your heart; do not depend on your own understanding. Seek his will in all you do,and he will show you which path to take.

text: How do we know we can resist temptation?
answer: 1 Corinthians 10:13 The temptations in your life are no different from what others experience. And God is faithful. He will not allow the temptation to be more than you can stand. When you are tempted, he will show you a way out so that you can endure.

text: How important is church attendance?
answer: Hebrews 10:25 And let us not neglect our meeting together, as some people do, but encourage one another, especially now that the day of his return is drawing near.

text: How powerful is God's Word?
answer: Hebrews 4:12 For the word of God is alive and powerful. It is sharper than the sharpest two-edged sword, cutting between soul and spirit, between joint and marrow. It exposes our innermost thoughts and desires.

text: How should a Christian do all things?
answer: Colossians 3:17 And whatever you do or say, do it as a representative of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks through him to God the Father.

text: How should a Christian treat those who mistreat him?
answer: Matthew 5:44 Love your enemies! Pray for those who persecute you!

text: Quote the invitation of Jesus contained in Revelation chapter three.
answer: Revelation 3:20 Look! I stand at the door and knock. If you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in, and we will share a meal together as friends.

text: Quote the Lord's Prayer?
answer: Matthew 6:9-13 Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come soon. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven. Give us today the food we need, and forgive us our sins, as we have forgiven those who sin against us. And don’t let us yield to temptation,but rescue us from the evil one.

text: Quote the two verses of First Thessalonians in which Paul describes the rapture of the church?
answer: 1 Thessalonians 4:16-17 For the Lord himself will come down from heaven with a commanding shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trumpet call of God. First, the believers who have died[a] will rise from their graves. Then, together with them, we who are still alive and remain on the earth will be caught up in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. Then we will be with the Lord forever.

text: Quote the verse in Psalms which tells us why believers do not need to fear death?
answer: Psalm 23:4 Even when I walk through the darkest valley, I will not be afraid, for you are close beside me. Your rod and your staffprotect and comfort me.

text: Quote the verse of First Corinthians chapter 15 in which Paul describes what will happen when Jesus returns?
answer: 1 Corinthians 15:52 It will happen in a moment, in the blink of an eye, when the last trumpet is blown. For when the trumpet sounds, those who have died will be raised to live forever. And we who are living will also be transformed.

text: Quote the verse of Matthew's gospel which tells of Jesus' supernatural birth.
answer: Matthew 1:23 Look! The virgin will conceive a child! She will give birth to a son, and they will call him Immanuel, which means ‘God is with us.’

text: Quote the verse of Philippians that tells us what to do instead of worrying.
answer: Philippians 4:6 Don’t worry about anything; instead, pray about everything. Tell God what you need, and thank him for all he has done.

text: Quote the verse of Philippians that tells us what we should think about.
answer: Philippians 4:8 And now, dear brothers and sisters, one final thing. Fix your thoughts on what is true, and honorable, and right, and pure, and lovely, and admirable. Think about things that are excellent and worthy of praise.

text: Quote the verse of Second Corinthians which speaks of all three members of the Trinity.
answer: 2 Corinthians 13:14 May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.

text: Quote the verse of Second Corinthians which tells us how to give.
answer: 2 Corinthians 9:7 You must each decide in your heart how much to give. And don’t give reluctantly or in response to pressure. For God loves a person who gives cheerfully.

text: Quote the verse which declares only Jesus can give us salvation.
answer: Acts 4:12 There is salvation in no one else! God has given no other name under heaven by which we must be saved.

text: Quote the words of Jesus which tell the purpose of the baptism in the Holy Spirit.
answer: Acts 1:8 But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you. And you will be my witnesses, telling people about me everywhere—in Jerusalem, throughout Judea, in Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.

text: What are the two verses in Matthew chapter six which tell us where we should store up treasures and why?
answer: Matthew 6:20,21 Store your treasures in heaven, where moths and rust cannot destroy, and thieves do not break in and steal.

text: What definition of faith is found in Hebrews 11:1?
answer: Hebrews 11:1 Faith shows the reality of what we hope for; it is the evidence of things we cannot see.

text: What did John say was his purpose for writing his Gospel?
answer: John 20:31 But these are written so that you may continue to believe that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God, and that by believing in him you will have life by the power of his name.

text: What does an Old Testament proverb say about hiding our sins?
answer: Proverbs 28:13 People who conceal their sins will not prosper,but if they confess and turn from them, they will receive mercy.

text: What great promise did Jesus make to His disciples concerning His return?
answer: John 14:3 When everything is ready, I will come and get you, so that you will always be with me where I am.

text: What saying of Jesus to Martha tells us that Jesus has power over death?
answer: John 11:25 I am the resurrection and the life. Anyone who believes in me will live, even after dying.

text: What verse in Psalms gives us guidance about TV and computer programs, movies, and other media?
answer: Psalm 101:3 I will refuse to look at anything vile and vulgar. I hate all who deal crookedly; I will have nothing to do with them.

text: What is the Christian's first responsibility in witnessing to the lost?
answer: Matthew 5:16 Let your good deeds shine out for all to see, so that everyone will praise your heavenly Father.

text: What is the great prophecy in Isaiah chapter nine concerning Jesus' birth?
answer: Isaiah 9:6 For a child is born to us,a son is given to us. The government will rest on his shoulders.And he will be called: Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

text: What prophecy did Isaiah make concerning Jesus' atoning death?
answer: Isaiah 53:5 But he was pierced for our rebellion, crushed for our sins. He was beaten so we could be whole. He was whipped so we could be healed.

text: What prophecy did Jesus make to Nicodemus concerning His atoning death?
answer: John 3:14-15 And as Moses lifted up the bronze snake on a pole in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up, so that everyone who believes in him will have eternal life.

text: What should be our greatest goal in life?
answer: Matthew 6:33 Seek the Kingdom of God above all else, and live righteously, and he will give you everything you need.

text: What should be our prayer about our speech and thoughts?
answer: Psalm 19:14 May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing to you, O LORD, my rock and my redeemer.

text: Why can we not trust our own judgment in choosing the right way to live?
answer: Proverbs 14:12 May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing to you, O LORD, my rock and my redeemer.

text: Why did God send His Son into the world?
answer: John 3:16-17 For this is how God loved the world: He gave[a] his one and only Son, so that everyone who believes in him will not perish but have eternal life. God sent his Son into the world not to judge the world, but to save the world through him.

text: Why should we study the Bible?
answer: 2 Timothy 2:15 Work hard so you can present yourself to God and receive his approval. Be a good worker, one who does not need to be ashamed and who correctly explains the word of truth.

text: Ephesians chapter four mentions what five ministry gifts?
answer: Apostles, Prophets, Evangelists, Pastors, Teachers

text: Following the Day of Pentecost, in what four things did the believers continue steadfastly?
answer: Apostle’s teaching, Fellowship, Sharing meals, including Communion [the Lord’s Supper], Prayer

text: From Proverbs chapter six, list five things which God hates.
answer: Proud look, Lying tongue, Hands that kill the innocent, Heart that plots evil, Feet that run to do wrong, False witness, One who causes trouble. (Accept any five answers.)

text: In the Parable of the Sower, to what four kinds of people did Jesus compare the soils?
answer: Those who allow Satan to steal the Word. Those who deny Christ [Jesus] when persecuted. Those who allow worldly things to dominate their lives. Those who receive the gospel and share it with others.

text: Is it possible to stop being a Christian?
answer: Yes, we must continue in faith and God's grace to remain God's children.

text: Jesus' parables in Luke chapter 15 deal with what three lost things?
answer: A lost sheep, A lost coin, A lost son

text: Romans chapter twelve lists what seven gifts of the Spirit?
answer: Prophesying, Serving, Teaching, Encouraging, Giving, Leadership, Showing kindness

text: When the prodigal son told his father he was only worthy to be a servant, what did the father do?
answer: Put the finest robe on him, Put a ring on his finger, Put sandals on his feet, Gave him a feast

text: Why should we not drink alcoholic beverages?
answer: Wine produces mockers; alcohol leads to brawls. Those led astray by drink cannot be wise.

text: Will all people be judged?
answer: Yes, Christians will be judged by Christ [God] to determine who deserves rewards, while those who refused Christ as Savior will be judged unworthy of eternal life.

text: First Corinthians chapter twelve lists what nine gifts of the Spirit?
answer: Giving wise advice, Message of special knowledge, Great faith, Gift of healing, Power to perform miracles, Prophecy, Discerning between spirits, Speaking in unknown languages [tongues], Interpretation of unknown languages [tongues].

text: First Corinthians chapter fourteen contains what two great rules for worship in the church?
answer: Everything should be done for the spiritual strengthening of the congregation. Everything should be done in a proper and orderly way.

text: Give five of Jesus' "I am" declarations from the Gospel of John.
answer: [I am the] Bread of Life, [I am the] Resurrection and the Life, [I am the] Light of the World, [I am the] Way, [the] Truth, and [the] Life, [I am the] Gate, [I am the] True [Vine] Grapevine, [I am the] Good Shepherd (Accept any five answers.)

text: Give nine of the characteristics of true Christian love.
answer: Patient, Kind, Not jealous, Not boastful or proud, Not rude or irritable, Not demanding of its own way, Keeps no record of wrongs, Does not rejoice about injustice, Rejoices when truth wins, Never gives up or loses faith, Hopeful, Enduring [Lasts forever] (Accept any nine answers.)

text: How can Christians live victoriously over sin?
answer: By yielding to God, claiming identification with the death and resurrection of Jesus, and allowing the [Holy] Spirit to lead us.

text: How does a church grow?
answer: When individual members of a church contribute their God-given gifts, then the church will be healthy and grow in love.

text: What twelve Old Testament books were written by the minor prophets?
answer: Hosea, Joel, Amos, Obadiah, Jonah, Micah, Nahum, Habakkuk, Zephaniah, Haggai, Zechariah, Malachi

text: What was Jesus' last command to His apostles before His ascension?
answer: Jesus told them not to leave Jerusalem until they had received the gift of the Holy Spirit [baptism in the Holy Spirit]

text: What are nine different signs of Jesus' soon return?
answer: Return of Jews to Israel, Increase in knowledge, Wars and threats of wars, Famines, Earthquakes, persecution of believers, many will turn away from Jesus, False prophets and messiahs, sin will be rampant, great anguish, all nations will hear the good news (Accept any 9 answers)

text: What are four things we should do in order to be more like Jesus?
answer: Learn the Word, Pray each day, Attend church services, Follow the [Holy] Spirit's leading

text: What are some evidences that a person is truly a Christian?
answer: Love for other Christians, Affirmation of the [Holy] Spirit, Bearing spiritual fruit

text: What are the eight General Epistles?
answer: Hebrews, James, 1&2 Peter, 1,2, & 3 John, Jude

text: What are the twelve books of Old Testament history?
answer: Joshua, Judges, Ruth, 1&2 Samuel, 1&2 Kings, 1&2 Chronicles, Ezra, Nehemiah, Esther

text: What are the thirteen epistles written by Paul?
answer: Romans, 1&2 Corinthians, Galatians, Ephesians, Philippians, Colossians, 1&2 Thessalonians, 1&2 Timothy, Titus, Philemon

text: What are the five books of Old Testament poetry?
answer: Job, Psalms, Proverbs, Ecclesiastes, Song of Solomon

text: What are the five books of New Testament history?
answer: Matthew, Mark, Luke, John, Acts

text: What are the five books of the New Testament written by John?
answer: Gospel of John, 1,2, & 3, John, Revelation

text: What does it mean to be a good steward?
answer: Being a good steward is recognizing that all we have and all we are has been given to us by God and is to be used wisely in furthering the work of God

text: What does the Bible tell us about the life of Jesus between the time He was 12 and 30?
answer: He obeyed His parents, grew mentally and physically, and gained favor with both God and people

text: What does the Bible say to do when others pressure us to disobey God?
answer: Do not follow others to do what is wrong. Obey God rather than human authority

text: What five books of the Bible are called the "Pentateuch"?
answer: Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy

text: What five Old Testament books were written by the major prophets?
answer: Isaiah, Jeremiah, Lamentations, Ezekiel, Daniel

text: What four natural or logical evidences do we have that the Bible is inspired?
answer: Findings of archaeology, Its unity, Its endurance, Its timelessness, Its influence on people and nations, its many fulfilled prophecies (Accept any four answers)

text: What four things does God ask us to do in order to receive His salvation?
answer: Ask God to save us, Believe Jesus [Christ] was raised from the dead, Confess and repent of our sins, Declare Jesus [Christ] as Savior and Lord

text: What four things should we do when we participate in the communion service?
answer: Remember Jesus' death, Look forward to His return, Examine our relationship with God, Enjoy fellowship with Jesus and our fellow Christians

text: What is meant by the fullness of Christ's atonement?
answer: That Jesus' death purchased both forgiveness from sin and freedom from its penalty

text: What is Paul's threefold advice concerning anger?
answer: Don't use anger as an excuse to sin, don’t hold grudges, don’t listen to the devil

text: What three persons did Jesus raise from the dead?
answer: Jairus' daughter, A widow's son, Lazarus

text: What three prophecies did Zechariah make about Jesus' betrayal?
answer: The betrayer would be paid 30 pieces of silver., The money would be thrown down in the temple, the money would be used to buy the potter's field

text: What three supernatural things happened on the Day of Pentecost?
answer: A sound like the roaring of a mighty windstorm was heard. Divided tongues of fire appeared. Disciples spoke in languages they had never learned.

text: Which of the Ten Commandments deal with our relationship with God?
answer: You must not have any other god before me. You must not make for yourself an idol of any kind. You must not misuse the name of the Lord your God. Remember to observe the Sabbath day by keeping it holy.

text: Which of the Ten Commandments deal with our relationship with others?
answer: Honor your father and mother. You must not murder. You must not commit adultery. You must not steal. You must not testify falsely against your neighbor. You must not covet anything that belongs to your neighbor

text: Who should become members of a local church?
answer: Those who: have accepted Christ as Savior; have been baptized in water; agree with the church’s teachings; pledge to support the church with tithe, talents, and attendance; and are willing to abide by the church's discipline

text: Who were the twelve apostles of Jesus?
answer: Simon Peter, Andrew, James, the son of Zebedee, John, Philip, Bartholomew, Thomas, Matthew, James, the son of Alpheus, Thaddeus, Simon the Zealot, Judas Iscariot

text: Who were the twelve sons of Jacob?
answer: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, Joseph, Benjamin, Dan, Naphtali, Gad, Asher
